_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Jwè Yon kont Dealer

📖 REZIME JWÈT LA:
• Ou kòmanse ak {start_chips} chip
• Dek kart 52 (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Ou jwe kont dealer (lakay)
• Chak rond swiv estrikti Ultimate Texas Hold'em: ou poste mize ANTE ak BLIND, resevwa 2 kart hole, deside sou mize PLAY opsyonèl atravè faz jwèt la, epi revele kart kominite ak konpare pi bon men 5-kat ou kont men dealer. Objektif ou se maximize ganans ou (lè ou gen men pi bon), pandan ou minimize pèt ou (lè ou gen men pi mal).
• Jwèt la fini lè ou rive 0 chip oswa pi ba nan kòmansman rond (PÈT) oswa konplè 1000 rond ak chip (GENYEN)

💰 ESTRIKTI MIZE:
• ANTE: Mize obligatwa ${ante} chak rond
• BLIND: Mize obligatwa ${ante} chak rond
• PLAY: Mize opsyonèl pandan jwèt la. Pandan rond la, ou ka chwazi YON SELMAN nan sa yo ki swiv: (${ante4} si ou fe li nan PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} si ou fe li nan FLOP, oswa ${ante} si ou fe li nan RIVER. Ou ka fold tou nan rivyè, abandone men ou, epi pa fe okenn mize.)

🎴 DISTRIKSYON KART:
• Ou resevwa 2 kart fas-wou (kart hole ou yo)
• Dealer resevwa 2 kart fas-wo (kache nan ou)
• 5 kart kominite deyal fas-wo anvan
• Kart kominite yo revele pwogresivman atravè faz jwèt la

🏆 KALIFIKASYON DEALER:
• Dealer dwe gen omwen YON PÈ (2 kart menm rang) kalifye, itilize 2 kart nan men li ak 5 kart kominite.
• Kalifikasyon dealer afekte rezilta mize yo, jan sa pral eksplike pi tard.

🎮 FAZ JWÈT & AKSYON:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Aksyon: [4x] (${ante4}) oswa [check]
  • [4x]: Mete ${ante4} mize PLAY, revele premye 3 kart kominite
  • [check]: Pa gen okenn mize adisyonèl, revele premye 3 kart kominite

📋 FLOP:
  • Si mize 4x mete: Sèlman [skip] disponib (oto-revele 2 kart kominite ki rete)
  • Si pa gen mize 4x: [2x] (${ante2}) oswa [check]
  • [2x]: Mete ${ante2} mize PLAY, revele 2 kart kominite ki rete
  • [check]: Pa gen okenn mize adisyonèl, revele 2 kart kominite ki rete

📋 RIVER:
  • Si mize 4x oswa 2x mete: Sèlman [skip] disponib (oto-pwosede a showdown)
  • Si pa gen okenn mize PLAY anvan: [1x] (${ante}) oswa [fold]
  • [1x]: Mete ${ante} mize PLAY, pwosede a showdown
  • [fold]: Abandone men ou, pèdi mize ANTE ak BLIND

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Tout kart yo revele ak evalye
  • Pi bon men 5-kat nan 7 kart (2 hole + 5 kominite)
  • Mize yo regle selon règ mize yo

💎 PÈ MIZE:
📊 MIZE ANTE:
  • Dealer pa kalifye: PUSH (mize retounen)
  • Dealer kalifye ak ou genyen: 1:1 pè (mize + ganans)
  • Dealer kalifye ak ou pèdi: Mize pèdi
  • Egalite: PUSH (mize retounen)

📊 MIZE BLIND:
  • Pa afekte pa kalifikasyon dealer
  • Ou genyen: Mize retounen ak pè adisyonèl baze sou fòs men ou
  • Ou pèdi: Mize pèdi
  • Egalite: PUSH (mize retounen)

📊 TABLO PÈ MIZE BLIND:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Moins ke Straight: Pa gen okenn pè adisyonèl

📊 MIZE PLAY:
  • Pa afekte pa kalifikasyon dealer
  • Konparasyon direk: Pi bon men ou kont pi bon men dealer
  • Ou genyen: 1:1 pè (mize + ganans)
  • Ou pèdi: Mize pèdi
  • Egalite: PUSH (mize retounen)

🎯 KLASMAN MEN POKÈ (Pi bon a Pi mal):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 menm kostim
  2. Straight Flush: 5 kart konsekif menm kostim
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 kart menm rang
  4. Full House: 3 menm rang + 2 menm rang
  5. Flush: 5 kart menm kostim
  6. Straight: 5 kart konsekif
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 kart menm rang
  8. Two Pair: 2 pè menm rang diferan
  9. One Pair: 2 kart menm rang
  10. High Card: Kart ki pi wo ap genyen

⌨️ KOMANDE AKSYON:
• [4x] oswa [play bet 4x]: Mete ${{self.ante_amount*4}} mize PLAY
• [2x] oswa [play bet 2x]: Mete ${{self.ante_amount*2}} mize PLAY
• [1x] oswa [play bet 1x]: Mete ${{self.ante_amount*1}} mize PLAY
• [check] oswa [c]: Cheke (pa gen okenn mize adisyonèl)
• [fold] oswa [f]: Fold (abandone men ou)
• [skip] oswa [s]: Sote a faz ki vinan (lè pa gen okenn aksyon ki nesesè)

💡 KONSÈY STRATEJI:
• Men kòmansman fò (pè, kart wo) souvan jisifye mize 4x
• Konsidere kalifikasyon dealer - men feb ki ka pouse si dealer pa kalifye
• Mize BLIND ka byen pwofitab ak men fò (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Gade chip ou! Si li desann a 0 oswa pi ba nan kòmansman rond, ou pèdi.

⚠️  REMAK ENPÒTAN:
• Mize ANTE ak BLIND yo obligatwa chak rond
• Mize PLAY yo opsyonèl ak estratejik
• Asire w ke ou mete aksyon ki kòrèk, e sèlman yon aksyon nan yon fwa.
